name: Formal Presentation
description: A structured talk delivered to an audience with visual aids, typically lasting 15-30 minutes

structure.opening: Clear introduction with hook and preview
structure.body: Logically organized main points with supporting evidence
structure.closing: Summary, call to action, and memorable ending

delivery.body_language: Formal stance, purposeful movement, deliberate gestures

visual_aids.recommendations: Clear, uncluttered slides with visual emphasis over text

requirements.interaction: Limited, typically Q&A at the end

best_practices: Rehearse multiple times with full setup
Use the rule of three for main points
Include stories or examples for engagement
Arrive early to check room setup
Have backup plans for visual aids

audience_expectations.content: Clear value proposition and relevant content
audience_expectations.materials: High-quality visual aids and potentially handouts

lightning_talk.key_differences: Highly focused content, faster pace, minimal visuals

keynote.description: Feature presentation at an event (30-60 minutes)
keynote.key_differences: Higher expectations, more storytelling, polished delivery

technical_presentation.description: Focus on technical content or demonstration
technical_presentation.key_differences: More detail, often includes live demonstration, slower pace

preparation_checklist: Define clear objective and key message
Create content outline with logical flow
Develop visual aids that enhance message
Prepare opening hook and closing statement
Visit venue or test virtual platform in advance
